response.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT sf.zoneref AS zoneref, s.entrystat AS entrystat, sf.traitcount AS traitcount FROM scanfeatures sf JOIN sites s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sf.traitcount > 489), g AS (SELECT zoneref, entrystat, AVG(traitcount) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM f GROUP BY zoneref, entrystat) SELECT zoneref AS site_code, entrystat AS access_status, avg_traitcount, record_count, CAST(record_count AS REAL) / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM g ORDER BY share_of_total DESC NULLS LAST, zoneref, entrystat LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: 'Passes the 489 threshold' means traitcount strictly greater than 489.

The overall total record count is the number of filtered (traitcount threshold and site-matched) feature records, so shares sum to 1 across all groups before the top 10 limit. If no records qualify, no rows are returned.
Share is computed as real (non-integer) division and not rounded. Ties in share are broken by site code, then access status.
